name: SIY - Style It Yourself
tagline: Shows how a new piece works with clothes you already own before you buy it.
problem: Shoppers buy items that match nothing they own, then buy more to match.
solution: Users upload their wardrobe; the assistant builds outfits and checks how a prospective purchase fits with existing pieces.
demo_moment: Team-described: add a jacket you are considering and see outfits from your own closet.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Frames intentional fashion around access, not owning less.

lessons: A beginner team won by picking a habit they personally had.
